_help: Fill every field from the Fastidious artefacts named beside it. Leave nothing to the model's defaults: whatever the brief does not say, the model will make generic.
_purpose_from: FRAME.md: the reframed problem, and why this film exists at all
_audience_from: POSITIONING.md: the one person, their pain, and what they should do after watching
_single_idea_from: BEAT-MAP.md or POSITIONING.md: the one sentence the film defends
_sign_from: SIGN-SYSTEM.md: what every frame should signify, in a few words
avoid: fake depth of field on everything

music._note: Choose before the shot list, so cuts can land on the beat.
